The '''Irradiator Box''' was a model of [[containment unit]] manufactured by [[Synthtech Medtech Corporation]]. A smaller unit, it used broad-spectrum [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], ultrasonics, and other methods to sterlize objects placed in the box to kill [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]], [[virus]]es and other contagions. The unit had its own rechargeable power sources, and was suitable for smaller items such as tools.<ref name="PSG" />
